text.title: FreshDrop, busy families, Moscow, August 2026
text.person: parents with 2+ children who order food weekly
text.problem: the courier comes late and the slot is lost; the order is cancelled and the family eats out
text.cause: slots are fixed by the shop, not by the family; no reminder
text.motivation: a dinner on time; the metric is orders delivered in the slot, target 90%
text.metric: share of orders delivered in the chosen slot
text.hypothesis: families lose a slot about once a month and want a reminder
text.who: 12 parents, interviewer and note-taker from the product team
text.extra: they plan the week on Sunday; they check the app three times a week
text.general: busy, two incomes, shop by phone and by app
text.context: they keep a list in a messenger and call the shop when a slot is missed
text.values: time with the children; food that is healthy and fresh
text.pains: a missed slot is the worst part of the week; the courier does not call
text.decision: hypothesis confirmed for 9 of 12 parents; build the reminder first
text.gaps: no answers from parents who order only once a month
